name: organza-store
description: Organza Store — npm workspace root. The four projects (shared, backend, admin, pos) install from here as one dependency tree.
_comment_workspaces: shared/ is listed first because it is the package the other three depend on. npm resolves the graph itself, so the order is documentation rather than mechanism — but `npm run build` below relies on it being built first, and that IS ordered explicitly.
_comment_scripts: Everything here fans out to the workspaces. Run per-app commands with `npm run <script> -w <app>` (e.g. `npm run dev -w backend`) — the -w flag takes the directory name as well as the package name.

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w admin && npm run build -w pos
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts._comment_api_test: Passthroughs, so the suite can be reached from the workspace root as well as from inside backend/. Both hit a real, already-running API — see backend/README.md.
